plan.title: The Last Ship
plan.logline: A lighthouse keeper receives a message from a ship lost at sea and chooses to rescue its last survivor.
plan.ending: The keeper, driven by a deep-seated sense of duty and a desire to protect the last remaining human, boards the ship, where he finds the ship's captain and the survivors, all lost in a storm. The keeper, with a heart of stone and a resolve to save, decides to use his knowledge of the ship's architecture and the ship's crew to guide the survivors through the storm, ultimately saving their lives.
